name: Clarion-Clipperton Zone
notes: Largest known nodule field; most ISA nodule contracts, including China Minmetals and COMRA.
source: ISA exploration areas; Hein et al. 2013 (Ore Geology Reviews 51)

name: Peru Basin
notes: DISCOL disturbance experiment site; no ISA contract.

name: Cook Islands / Penrhyn Basin
source: Hein et al. 2013; Cook Islands Seabed Minerals Authority

name: Western Pacific nodules (Minamitorishima / Marcus-Wake)
notes: Japanese EEZ nodules; COMRA western Pacific area nearby.

name: Prime Crust Zone (west)
notes: Seamounts of the Magellan, Marcus-Wake and Marshall chains; Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Russian ISA crust contracts.

name: Prime Crust Zone (east of 180)
notes: Mid-Pacific Mountains and Line Islands seamounts.

name: Mid-Atlantic Ridge (north)
notes: Russian, French and Polish ISA sulphide contracts.

name: Central Indian Ridge
notes: India and Germany ISA sulphide contracts.

name: Okinawa Trough
notes: Back-arc hydrothermal fields; Japanese and Chinese research. Overlaps East China Sea oil and gas.

name: North Fiji Basin
notes: Back-arc spreading centre west of the date line (the Lau box covers east of it).

name: East Pacific Rise
notes: Mid-ocean ridge hydrothermal vents; mostly scientific.

name: Minamitorishima REE mud
notes: Japanese EEZ deep-sea mud with high rare-earth content; the main deep-sea rare-earth prospect.

name: South-east Pacific REE mud
notes: Broad area of REE-enriched pelagic clay; low confidence.

name: Chatham Rise
notes: New Zealand; mining consent applied for and refused.
source: Chatham Rock Phosphate; CER seabed-mining review

name: Namibian shelf phosphate
source: SAIIA briefing on Namibian seabed mining

name: North Sea
notes: Major offshore basin; also wind farms and cable routes.

name: South China Sea
notes: Pearl River Mouth, Qiongdongnan, Spratly basins; also territorial patrols.

name: East China Sea shelf
notes: Xihu depression and Jeju Basin (reaches the Yellow Sea box at 34N); disputed waters.

name: Gulf of Guinea / Angola
notes: Niger Delta and Angolan deep water.

name: Central Arctic Ocean
commodities: Extended continental shelf claims, ice and climate research
notes: Lawnmower surveys here usually map the seabed for UNCLOS Article 76 shelf claims or science, not mining; Chukchi Borderland is a frequent Chinese research target.

name: Southern Ocean
notes: Mineral resource activity is prohibited south of 60 S (Madrid Protocol).
